title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for chronic kidney disease.

HPI
The patient presents today for a scheduled follow-up of chronic kidney disease. The patient reports feeling generally well but notes occasional fatigue. They have been stable on their current medication regimen. There are no new symptoms of electrolyte imbalance or significant fluid retention reported since the last visit.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg daily, Amlodipine 5mg daily.

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. Vital signs show stable blood pressure. Physical exam reveals no significant edema or peripheral pulses. Skin is clear without new lesions.

Assessment
The patient has chronic kidney disease, currently at stage 5. The patient also has hypertension. Renal function remains stable on current management.

Plan
Continue current medication regimen for hypertension and chronic kidney disease. Monitor blood pressure and laboratory values at the next visit. Follow up in three months for a repeat metabolic panel and renal function tests.
explanations: Hypertension with CKD stage 5 or ESRD: I12.0, plus N18.5/N18.6.
CKD stage 5 (not documented as ESRD): N18.5.

distractors.why: I12.9 is for stage 1-4 or unspecified CKD.
The classification presumes a link between hypertension and CKD.
